examples.en: Surveys indicate that supporters of the treaty are still in the majority.
examples.zh: 调查显示该条约的支持者仍占多数。

examples.en: Surveys consistently find that men report feeling safe on the street after dark. See, for example, Hindelang and Garofalo (1978, p.127).
examples.zh: 调查一致显示，男性天黑后在街上感到安全。可参见如欣德朗和加罗法洛的著作(1978年，127页)。

examples.en: She conducted surveys of many soldiers.
examples.zh: 她对许多士兵进行了调查。
